title: Wakanda Festival 2027 Paris – 6th edition (Official)
description:
🔥🔥𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗘 𝗧𝗢 𝗪𝗔𝗞𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗔 𝗙𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗩𝗔𝗟 (𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗜𝗡 𝗢𝗡𝗘) 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲 – 6𝘁𝗵 𝗘𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 🔥🔥
The Wakanda team has the honor to welcome you into the kingdom of Wakanda for 3 days of madness. A place full of good vibes, quality atmosphere, joy, and a common wish to share our passion for dance and music.
For your comfort, we have chosen the luxurious 4-star hotel 𝗩𝗮𝗻 𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝗩𝗮𝗹𝗸 𝗛𝗼𝘁𝗲𝗹 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗶𝘀 𝗖𝗗𝗚 𝗔𝗶𝗿𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 with more than 600 m2 of dance space.
Adress: 351 Av. du Bois de la Pie, CS 42048 Paris Nord 2, Roissy-en-France, Île-de-France, France, 95912
